skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts of mapping, digital maps, and GIS, including the components and principles of GIS.
Organize, collect, integrate, and manage spatial databases from various sources.
Process and analyze spatial data using GIS software.
Apply GIS knowledge to solve resource management problems.
Work effectively in teams to select topics and solve problems in resource markets and products.
Analyze, evaluate, and synthesize information from maps to support professional tasks.
Present and discuss findings effectively in group settings.
Conduct independent research and propose topics for group projects.
